models.name: Learned payment patterns
models.task: Similarity to scam patterns in a synthetic payment-request benchmark
models.eligible_population: Synthetic wallet payments with complete risk-features-v1 snapshots
models.limitation: Synthetic-only, uncalibrated advisory score. Not DS-approved for prevention or real customer decisions. Final-test gate: failed

models.name: Learned payment behavior
models.task: Observed payment behavior compared with generator-labelled scam examples; cannot rule out deception
models.eligible_population: Synthetic payments with versioned prepayment inputs
models.limitation: Advisory only; uncalibrated and not approved to block payments. Failed the synthetic prevention gate.

models.name: Learned request patterns
models.task: Learned prepayment request and channel patterns in a synthetic corpus
models.eligible_population: Synthetic payments with versioned prepayment inputs
models.limitation: Advisory only; uncalibrated and not approved to block payments. Failed the synthetic prevention gate.

models.name: AE ledger behavior classifier
models.task: Compare transaction amount, channel, type and prior wallet activity with AE-labelled fraud patterns
models.eligible_population: Settled synthetic wallet transfers with frozen ledger-features-v2
models.limitation: Synthetic temporal test: 20/255 fraud detected; 6/151 legitimate flagged. Low scores cannot clear a complaint. Uncalibrated; not approved to block.
